description: Front B (broad catalog), O11 Reactive lane: port of tests/jobs-odc/ui-flow-comment.json and of the popover/metadata part of tests/jobs-odc/email-popover-metadata.json. (1) Comment on the canvas of the UI flow: QUALIFIED OutSystems type OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IComment (the bare name also exists in UI.Web); in O11 the interface has Text and IsReminder writable and no Name (model-api-11.55.69), so the name of the create proves nothing; two comments, the second with IsReminder=true (the Reminder message is declared) and moved apart with move x/y. (2) The flow IMobileFlow:MainFlow read with get and dump, where the comments appear next to the screens. (3) IPopover of the NRWidgets plugin, in a screen: in O11 the own writable properties are PopoverWidth and Style (there is no Width), and TopContent/BottomContent are born with the widget. (4) ITextMetadata hung on an IScreenAggregate through CreateMetadata<T>(name, managedBy) (IAggregate in O11), with Value and Hidden. The email of the ODC job stays OUT: the O11 11.55.87 runtime does not load OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileEmail (overlays-email.json, o11 limit). Nothing here has been run natively yet.

expectedMessages.why: IsReminder=true makes the platform emit a Reminder message with the text of the comment itself: it is the meaning of the property and what this job proves (same as the ODC job ui-flow-comment). The comment with IsReminder=false emits nothing. In O11 the element comes out as CommentNode (the flow comment has no name; measured in probe B-006 phase 1).
